cards.ex: The two countries are on the brink of war after the border dispute.
cards.exUz: Ikki davlat chegaradagi bahsdan so'ng urush yoqasida.
cards.uzDef: Urush boshlanishi xavfi juda yuqori bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: There's a lot of animosity between the two political parties.
cards.exUz: Ikki siyosiy partiya o'rtasida katta adovat bor.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli dushmanlik, nafrat hissi.

cards.ex: He's fighting a losing battle trying to save the company.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyani qutqarishga urinib, befoyda kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish imkoni bo'lmagan kurashni davom ettirmoq.

cards.ex: They took up arms to defend their land.
cards.exUz: Ular o'z yerlarini himoya qilish uchun qurol ko'tarishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qurolli kurashga qo'shilish, urushga tayyorlanmoq.

cards.ex: Open hostilities began after the attack on the embassy.
cards.exUz: Elchixonaga qilingan hujumdan so'ng urush harakatlari boshlandi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq urush, qurolli to'qnashuvlar boshlanishi.

cards.ex: We need a cooling-off period before we can discuss this calmly.
cards.exUz: Buni xotirjam muhokama qilishdan oldin bizga tinchlanish davri kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yumshatish uchun mo'ljallangan vaqt oralig'i.

cards.ex: The politician's speech inflamed passions among the protesters.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchining nutqi namoyishchilar orasida nafratni qo'zg'atdi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli his-tuyg'ularni, g'azabni, nafratni kuchaytirish.

cards.ex: I don't think fighting fire with fire is the right approach here.
cards.exUz: O'ylaymanki, bu yerda o't bilan o'chni o'chirish to'g'ri yondashuv emas.
cards.uzDef: Xuddi shunday usullar bilan kurashish, javoban tajovuzkor bo'lish.

cards.ex: The scandal led to a breakdown in relations between the two companies.
cards.exUz: Janjal ikki kompaniya o'rtasidagi aloqalarning buzilishiga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlarning keskin yomonlashuvi, aloqa yo'qligi.

cards.ex: The two countries seem to be on a collision course.
cards.exUz: Ikki davlat to'qnashuv yo'lida ketayotganga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Ziddiyatli vaziyatga olib keladigan yo'nalishda harakatlanish.

cards.ex: There's deep-seated resentment in the community after the factory closure.
cards.exUz: Zavod yopilgandan so'ng jamiyatda chuqur xafagarchilik bor.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri saqlanib qolgan, kuchli xafagarchilik hissi.

cards.ex: I don't want to rock the boat, but I think we need to discuss this.
cards.exUz: Vaziyatni buzishni xohlamayman, lekin buni muhokama qilishimiz kerak deb o'ylayman.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud vaziyatni o'zgartirishga harakat qilish, muammolarni keltirib chiqarish.

cards.ex: We need to nip this problem in the bud before it gets worse.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni yomonlashmasdan oldin ildizida yo'q qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yoki xavfni boshidanoq to'xtatish, rivojlanishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik.

cards.ex: The new tax law is a major point of contention.
cards.exUz: Yangi soliq qonuni asosiy bahs nuqtasi hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilik, bahsga sabab bo'ladigan narsa yoki masala.

cards.ex: We need to find a way to break the deadlock in the negotiations.
cards.exUz: Biz muzokaralardagi turdni buzish yo'lini topishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday taraqqiyot bo'lmayotgan vaziyatdan chiqish yo'lini topish.

cards.ex: The country declared war on its neighbor.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat qo'shnisiga urush e'lon qildi.
cards.uzDef: Rasman urush boshlash haqida e'lon qilish.

cards.ex: The dictator established a reign of terror.
cards.exUz: Diktator vahshat hukmronligini o'rnatdi.
cards.uzDef: Zo'ravonlik, qo'rquv va bosim orqali boshqaruv.

cards.ex: They're fighting a war of attrition, hoping the enemy will run out of supplies.
cards.exUz: Ular dushmanni asta-sekin zaiflashtirishga harakat qilib, charchatish urushi olib borishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Dushmanni asta-sekin zaiflashtirishga qaratilgan urush.

cards.ex: The uneasy truce held for only a few weeks.
cards.exUz: Noaniq sulh atigi bir necha hafta davom etdi.
cards.uzDef: Barqaror bo'lmagan, tezda buzilishi mumkin bo'lgan sulh.

cards.ex: I tried to pour oil on troubled waters, but it didn't work.
cards.exUz: Men vaziyatni yumshatishga harakat qildim, lekin bu ish bermadi.
cards.uzDef: Tinchlik o'rnatishga harakat qilish, vaziyatni tinchlantirish.

cards.ex: Sending in more troops will only escalate the conflict.
cards.exUz: Ko'proq qo'shin yuborish faqat ziddiyatni kuchaytiradi.
cards.uzDef: Ziddiyatni jiddiylashtirish, keskinlashtirish.

cards.ex: He took the heat for the company's mistakes.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyaning xatolari uchun zarbani o'ziga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Tanqid yoki aybni qabul qilish, o'z zimmasiga olish.

cards.ex: His comments were intended to sow discord among the team members.
cards.exUz: Uning izohlari jamoa a'zolari o'rtasida nifoq solishga qaratilgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilik, nifoq, adovat yaratish.

cards.ex: The military conducted a show of force near the border.
cards.exUz: Harbiylar chegara yaqinida kuch ko'rsatishdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z kuchini, qudratini namoyish qilish.

cards.ex: Journalists are often in the line of fire when reporting from conflict zones.
cards.exUz: Jurnalistlar ko'pincha ziddiyat zonalaridan xabar berishda xavf ostida bo'lishadi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatda bo'lish, tanqid yoki hujum ostida qolish.

cards.ex: You have to tread carefully when discussing politics with family.
cards.exUz: Oila bilan siyosatni muhokama qilganda ehtiyotkor bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nozik vaziyatda ehtiyotkorlik bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: An armistice was signed to end the fighting.
cards.exUz: Janglarni to'xtatish uchun sulh imzolandi.
cards.uzDef: Urushayotgan tomonlarning urushni to'xtatish haqidagi kelishuvi.

cards.ex: The humanitarian aid workers risked their lives entering the zone of conflict.
cards.exUz: Gumanitar yordam xodimlari ziddiyat zonasiga kirib hayotlarini xavf ostiga qo'yishdi.
cards.uzDef: Urush yoki zo'ravonlik sodir bo'layotgan hudud.

cards.ex: The police were able to defuse the situation before it got out of hand.
cards.exUz: Politsiya vaziyatni nazoratdan chiqmasdan oldin yumshata oldi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki keskin vaziyatni tinchlantirish.

cards.ex: The Cold War dominated international politics for decades.
cards.exUz: Sovuq urush o'nlab yillar davomida xalqaro siyosatda hukmronlik qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qurolli to'qnashuvsiz siyosiy va iqtisodiy qarama-qarshilik.
